messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Problem accessing RStudio on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi
 Not strictly Shiny, but obviously associated

I have recently set up a website on AWS running Ubuntu and have successfully installed
shiny-server and several apps

I have followed the instructions
https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/200552306-Getting-Started

as best I can and when I verify installation get
rstudio-server start/running, process 2304

However I am having problems connecting via the internet
with http://mytinyshinys.com:8787 which replicates  the method to get to the version on glimmer
I have tried the elastic ip number as well

Is it because the site defaults to the shiny-server port 3838?

Anyways could do with some help

cheers

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Problem accessing RStudio on Ubuntu
parts:
Andrew,

I doubt that this is a conflict with shiny-server port (as long as you are not using port 8787 for shiny-server, which I don't think you are).

It might have been a problem with rstudio-server startup. 

You could run this command to check your installation:  "sudo rstudio-server verify-installation"

You could also check these log files for possible errors:   

/var/log/upstart/rstudio-server.log
/var/log/syslog

Also, please check for any configuration files in this location: 

/etc/rstudio

If you have older files in this location (from previous installations), check to see if the content is still valid.

Hope this can help you troubleshoot the problem. Let us know how it goes.

Fereshteh

Andrew,

As far as know you need to have an account on the rstudio-server machine. And after your first login, if you do not log out, the information is cached, and you do not need to enter your username/password every time. Not sure if this helps you. 

Fereshteh
